[Section] Experiments ::: Downstream Task Transfer ::: NER
[source_id=31] We use the English portion of the CoNLL 2003 dataset BIBREF20, which provides named entity annotations on newswire data across four different entity types (PER, LOC, ORG, MISC). A bidirectional LSTM-CRF architecture BIBREF14 and a BIOUL tagging scheme were used.
